messages.subject: Re: The data content is not shown, as html output. Why?
parts: When you view source you are not seeing the HTML of the living page; you're only seeing the HTML that was initially returned at page load time. If you want to see the live DOM you'll need to use the browser's inspector tool (right click on an element and choose Inspect Element, at least that's what it is on Chrome). You can generally right click on elements in the inspector pane and copy as HTML.
